verdict.rationale: Adyen for Platforms supports event-driven automation via webhooks (avoiding polling) and lets platforms 'configure your own monitoring rules and mitigations' for fraud/risk, plus custom payout schedules and split-payment instructions triggered by transaction events, but this is limited to a few pre-defined domains (payouts, risk, chargebacks) rather than a general-purpose rules engine for arbitrary events/actions. Missing for 10: a documented general rules/automation engine covering diverse event types and custom actions, and independent evidence of real-world automation workflows built on these primitives.
